answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reset on any identity-link attempt, rewards vest against future work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the quartz of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the onyx until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the walnut of the next round.
